stem: Two dice are thrown. Select every outcome whose total is $9$, then read $P$.
solution: The sample space is the whole $6 \times 6$ grid: $n(S) = 36$ outcomes.
A total of $9$ happens $4$ different ways, and order matters — the first die and the second did different things.
Count CELLS, not values. That is the trap: 'a total of 7' is one value and six outcomes.
